name: sibling-only-one-photo-fits
about: The second picture of a flatbed job whose kit holds one flatbed tractor and one reefer trailer seen from behind: it stays on the photo that fits rather than leave the job to be different.

recipe.name: Fixture concept
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our tractor on an open highway at {time_of_day}, {light}, photographed from {viewpoint}, no text, no logos, no lettering

equipment_photos.label: white tractor with a flatbed trailer, front three-quarter view
reefer trailer, rear view, doors closed

input.idea: Lead with the equipment: newer trucks, kept up.

slots.time_of_day: golden hour on a late-summer evening
slots.light: low warm sun raking across the cab, long shadows on the pavement, glowing sky
slots.viewpoint: a low angle near the road surface, ahead of the cab and to one side, looking up

slots.time_of_day: first light on a humid spring morning, pine woods lining the highway
